explanation.headline: FDA's records trace our supply to a plant classified OAI 510 days before the posting

sentences.text: FDA first posted the hydromorphone hydrochloride injection shortage on 2017-10-31 and it remains Current as of 2026-10-21.
The shortage posting lists Fresenius Kabi USA LLC, Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc., Hospira Inc. (a Pfizer Company), and Teva Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. as affected companies.
FDA inspection 976095 at Hospira Inc. (FEI 1925262) ended 2016-06-08 and was classified OAI, 510 days before the shortage posting.
A Warning Letter was issued to Hospira Inc. (FEI 1925262) on 2017-02-14, 259 days before the posting.
FDA inspection 1031233 at Hospira Inc. (FEI 1925262) ended 2017-10-27 and was classified VAI, 4 days before the posting.
Corvale East has 2.8 days of 2 mg/mL 20 mL vials on hand while Corvale General has 21.3 days.
The rule‑ranked best option is to transfer 139 vials of 2 mg/mL 20 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East, which would give Corvale East 9 days of supply.
